#!/usr/bin/env node
// @ts-check
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

export class Robot extends EventTarget {
  #name;
  static #count = 0;
  static { Robot.#count = 0; }
  constructor(name = 'r') { super(); this.#name = name; Robot.#count++; }
  get name() { return this.#name; }
  async *walk(n) { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) yield await Promise.resolve(i); }
  toString() { return `Robot(${this.#name})`; }
}

export const parse = (s) => s?.trim?.() ?? '';
export default function main({ a = 1, ...rest } = {}) {
  const re = /^(?<year>\d{4})-(?<m>\d{2})$/u;
  const m = '2024-01'.match(re)?.groups;
  label: for (const [k, v] of Object.entries({ a, ...rest })) { if (!v) continue label; }
  const big = 10n ** 20n;
  const obj = { [`k${a}`]: 1, async f() {}, get g() { return 1 }, 'quoted-key': 2 };
  let x = 0; x ||= 1; x &&= 2; x ??= 3;
  return [m, big, obj, path.basename('a/b'), readFile];
}
